description:
Leidos is seeking an AI Software Developer to join the Airports, Borders, and Security (AB&S) Business Area within the Homeland Sector, building the Travel & Customs Orchestration Platform — a hybrid-cloud, AI-driven system that senses data across the traveler journey (ATC data, manifests, border processing, detection/security, kiosks, e-Gates, staffing, and capacity), predicts demand, orchestrates resources, and measures outcomes.

 In this position, you will design and implement software solutions independently while working closely with systems engineering, product delivery, and DevSecOps teams. The primary focus is on developing microservices-based applications that power the platform's Sense → Predict → Orchestrate → Measure operating model, including the AI Detection Algorithm Marketplace used to evaluate and deploy third-party and in-house detection algorithms (prohibited items, explosives, weapons, liquids, novel threats, behavioral indicators, and future algorithm types). Experience with AI-enabled or data-driven systems is advantageous. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.

 This role focuses on building and modernizing real-time, mission-critical systems that directly support border and aviation security operations — including dynamic staffing allocation, checkpoint and lane management, passenger routing, exception management, passenger communications, cross-functional alerting, performance reporting, and predictive maintenance — while applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability. The platform serves stakeholders across the traveler journey, including TSA, CBP/ICE, airport operators, eu-LISA, airlines, Frontex, ground handlers, and passengers themselves.

 **This is a Hybrid position; the candidate will be in the office (Reston, VA) 3 days a week. 
 


 What You’ll Do: 
 Design and build microservices supporting the platform’s Sense → Predict → Orchestrate → Measure model
 Integrate real-time data feeds (ATC, manifests, border processing, detection/security, kiosks, e-Gates) and contribute to the AI Detection Algorithm Marketplace
 Deliver features like dynamic staffing allocation, lane management, passenger routing, and predictive maintenance
 Work in an Agile/SAFe team with systems engineering, DevSecOps, and QA
 Write clean, tested code and use AI-assisted tools to speed development and improve quality
 Support troubleshooting, performance tuning, and continuous improvement to reduce wait times and increase throughput
 Implement modern automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 BS/BA degree and 5 years related experience OR Master’s with 2 years of related experience; 4 years of related experience in lieu of degree
 Ability to obtain/maintain Public Trust; U.S. citizenship is required
 1 year software development experience supporting a related industry border/aviation customer (TSA, CBP/ICE, eu-LISA, Frontex, airport operators, airlines)
 Hands-on experience with microservices and at least one modern language (Java, Python, C++)
 Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and/or AI/ML-enabled systems
 Experience enhancing and maintaining existing software systems while preserving operational stability
 Ability to navigate large, complex distributed systems and translate them into higher-level architecture
 Agile experience; understanding of APIs and distributed systems
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 SAFe, Kafka/event streaming, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevSecOps experience
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
October 6, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
